all_quotes.quote: In this paper, we present a chemical study of four FUor-like eruptive young stars: L1551 IRS 5, Haro 5a IRS, OO Ser, and V346 Nor, using ALMA Band 6 observations.

Our aim is to investigate the chemical composition of four FUor-like Class I YSOs: L1551 IRS 5, Haro 5a IRS, V346 Nor, and OO Ser, and to compare their abundances of COMs with other YSOs in the literature.
The four FUor-like sources were observed as part of the ALMA program 2016.1.00209.S (PI: Takami) in Cycle 4.
